name: plot.polynomial
title: plot draws the polynomial and a dashed grid. The check is the curve values.

origin.description: plot draws the polynomial and a dashed grid. The check is the curve values.
origin.details: The curve on (0, 1), five points, is the polynomial values. Matplotlib draws that line.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example: png(tempfile()); p <- polynomial(c(1, 2, 1)); plot(p, xlim = c(0, 1), len = 5); xlim <- c(0, 1); eps <- diff(xlim)/100; xlim <- xlim + c(-eps, eps); x <- seq(xlim[1], xlim[2], len = 5); paste(sprintf("%.17g", predict(p, x)), collapse=",")
